data.name: StikDebug
data.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and debugger
data.localizedDescription: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.
data.versionDescription:
StikDebug 3.1.11 | StikDebug-3.1.11

Transitions to mounting the DDI via cryptex, should fix issues with the iPhone 18 Pro series.

## What's Changed
* Add Malloc Debugging by @Leviidev in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/460

## New Contributors

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/compare/3.1.10...3.1.11
